column1: # Extra create_osm_zim.py flags for one region, read by ops/build-region-fast.sh
# (a data file: a flag reaches one region without editing the build script).
# (Every region is built with --ocr since 2026-10-28; Bahrain tested it first.)
# Antarctica: imagery and terrain to zoom 11. The box is 360 degrees wide (zoom 12 would be
# 4.9 million tiles of each), and inland the imagery is one flat white.
# Antarctica with the South Pole: a map in a projection of its own. Its registry box is in map positions, so
# build-region-fast.sh refuses it (cut from the planet by that box it would be the Gulf of Guinea);
# ops/build-antarctica-polar.py builds it and passes this flag itself.
